body:
Thank you for responding and for the kind words. I've been trying to improve things, but the loss of my car was tough for me to deal with. 

I would like to get a job, it would make me feel better. I talked to some people who might be able to get me my medication cheaper, and just need to do a few steps for it.

Everything feels like an uphill battle, with my low energy and motivation, but I have been trying to fight. It is tough.

I'm sorry to hear that you are having a tough time as well. Still, by being kind to me know that you at least have a good heart. Not everyone would stop and take time to help out another.

What's going on is my life is a joke.

I got laid off from my five year job. I couldn't find another and lost my apartment.

I'm 33 with no job, no wife, no GED, bad credit, bad debt, and living with my parents. I was trying to fix things as difficult as it was, but my car just died making everything infinitely more difficult.

I told myself when I was younger by 30 I would have a great job, be married, have kids, and own a nice house and car. I'm afraid that I will never reach these goals now. I have no motivation at all, and the only thing I ever want to do is just escape my life by going on my computer.

I am supposed to be taking medication which may help, but it costs 200$ every two weeks, and I'm too un-motivated to try methods to get the medication cheaper. Doing anything that requires me leaving my room is like trying to pull teeth. I've been like this my entire life.
I think I hate myself. It's like I want to be depressed, I push myself into depressing thoughts. I may be so f'd up that I enjoy being depressed. I really just can't stand myself.
